name: Affinity
description: Bring your Affinity data into Claude to search contacts, companies, and deals; prep for meetings using your actual notes and interaction history; and update records as deals progress. Every email captured, every meeting logged, every relationship scored by your firm is now available directly in the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Affinity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Affinity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.affinity.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Affinity MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Affinity lists 31 MCP tools, including create_list_entry, create_note, create_reminder, get_company_info, get_company_list_entries, get_current_user, get_entities_attached_to_note, get_entity_field_values, get_entity_fields, get_list_entries, get_list_field_dropdown_options, and get_list_fields.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Affinity?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Affinity in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Affinity requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Affinity is developed by Affinity. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
